description: turbinesFoam is Peter Bachant and contributors' OpenFOAM library for wind and marine hydrokinetic turbine simulation. It represents blades through actuator lines and supplies turbine classes that can be added to compatible flow solvers through fvOptions. Inputs are flow conditions, turbine geometry, operating settings and a computational mesh; outputs are simulated flow and turbine-response quantities. Spatial resolution and duration follow the host CFD setup. Source is free under GPL-3.0-or-later, confirmed in the licence file, with build instructions and tutorial cases. A limitation is that actuator lines approximate blade effects and depend on projection, mesh and turbulence choices; compatibility must be checked for the chosen OpenFOAM release. turbinesFoam can evaluate wind or tidal-energy infrastructure configurations. OpenFOAM (model-openfoam) is its host solver family. The repository cites an actuator-line study of vertical-axis turbines. No mesh, model archive or container image was downloaded.
